detail:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: AGENTS.md
@@
-- Every endpoint is behind sign-in. Restrict actions with `[RequireRole("...")]`: destructive actions are Admin only, approvals are Approver or Admin.
+- Keep every endpoint behind sign-in. Restrict destructive actions to Admin.
 - Business rules go in the Domain project, never in controllers.
 - Register services in `Program.cs`. Repositories are interfaces in Domain with an in-memory implementation in Api.
 - Every new rule or endpoint needs tests. Use `FakeInvoiceRepository` in tests.
 - Use clear names; no one-letter variables or `flag` parameters.
 - End-to-end tests use page objects and role-based locators (`getByRole`, `getByLabel`), never CSS or XPath selectors.
 
+## Approval limits (`feature/approval-limits`)
+
+- Let a Manager approve amounts up to and including 50,000.00.
+- Let a Director approve amounts up to and including 500,000.00.
+- Require two distinct approvers above 500,000.00: first a Manager or Director, then a Director.
+- Compare usernames after trimming and ignoring case; never count one user twice.
+- Deny Admin approval; Manager and Director replace Approver.
+- For a denied attempt, throw `ApprovalDeniedException` with an actionable reason; change no fields and do not call `Update`.
+- Test boundaries 50,000.00, 50,000.01, 500,000.00 and 500,000.01.
+- Keep approval rules in `InvoiceApp.Domain`; use no role strings or HTTP types there.
+- Map the session to Domain types in controllers, then call `Handle(...)`.
+- Map `ApprovalDeniedException` in `ApiControllerBase` to `403 { "error": reason }`.
+- Validate first and change state last.
+
 ## Commands
 
 - Run the app: `dotnet run --project backend/src/InvoiceApp.Api` then open http://localhost:5000
 - Run the tests: `dotnet test backend/InvoiceApp.sln`
-- Run end-to-end tests: `cd e2e && npm install && npx playwright install chromium && npm test`
+- From `backend/tests/InvoiceApp.Tests`, run mutation tests: `dotnet stryker --project InvoiceApp.Domain.csproj` (Stryker 4.13.0).
+- From `e2e`, run end-to-end tests: `npx playwright test`.
 
 ## Demo accounts (not real credentials)
 
-- `demo.approver` / `ChangeMe123!` (role Approver)
+- `demo.manager` / `ChangeMe123!` (role Manager)
+- `demo.director` / `ChangeMe123!` (role Director)
+- `demo.director2` / `ChangeMe123!` (role Director)
 - `demo.admin` / `ChangeMe123!` (role Admin)
 
+## Agent workflow
+
+- Read the Implementer, Test Critic and PR Reviewer skills by path in `.github/skills`.
+- Write the spec first with OpenSpec; handle one task group per prompt.
+- Write tests first; consider a rule done only when a test fails if the rule is removed.
+- Format commits as `<type>(<scope>): <what>` and include a `Why:` line.
+- Let hooks write `docs/ai-log`; never edit it.
+
+## Review expectations
+
+- Report findings in a table: `| ID | Severity | File:line | Finding | Suggested fix |`.
+- Number findings from F-01 upward; use High, Medium or Low severity.
+- Check negative rules assert the invoice is unchanged and all four boundaries are tested.
+- Check nothing changes state before validation and no rule sits in a controller or `app.js`.
+- Check error text is fit for a user.
+
 ## Never
 
 - Commit real credentials, tokens or customer data.
 - Add business logic to `Program.cs` or controllers.
*** End Patch

detail:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: .github/skills/approval-rules/SKILL.md
+---
+name: approval-rules
+description: Approval role limits, outcomes, and required denial tests.
+---
+
+# Approval rules
+
+Follow [AGENTS.md](../../../AGENTS.md); do not duplicate its guidance.
+
+| Role | Amount band | Outcome |
+|---|---:|---|
+| Manager | ≤ 50,000.00 | May approve as the sole approver |
+| Manager | > 50,000.00 through 500,000.00 | Deny |
+| Manager | > 500,000.00 | May be first approver only |
+| Director | ≤ 500,000.00 | May approve as the sole approver |
+| Director | > 500,000.00 | May be first approver; may be second only if distinct |
+| Admin | Any amount or stage | Deny |
+| Any role | > 500,000.00, second approval | Require a distinct Director; prior Manager or Director is eligible |
+
+Boundaries to test: 50,000.00, 50,000.01, 500,000.00, and 500,000.01.
+Compare usernames after trimming and ignoring case; never count one user twice.
+
+| Case | Expected outcome |
+|---|---|
+| First approver `demo.director`, second `" Demo.Director "` | Deny as the same user |
+| Manager attempts the second approval above 500,000.00 | Deny |
+| Each denial, including boundary and role denials | Assert every invoice field equals its pre-attempt value and `UpdateCount` is 0 |
+
+Test valid distinct Manager→Director and Director→Director approvals above 500,000.00.
+All denial tests must assert both the actionable denial and the unchanged-invoice invariant.
*** Add File: .github/skills/tdd-step/SKILL.md
+---
+name: tdd-step
+description: Complete one task group or bug list with a focused test-first change.
+---
+
+Follow [AGENTS.md](../../../AGENTS.md); do not duplicate its guidance.
+
+For one task group or bug list:
+1. Write focused failing tests for the requested behavior.
+2. Run exactly `dotnet test backend/InvoiceApp.sln --nologo -v q`.
+3. Show that the tests fail for the expected reason, not a setup or compile error.
+4. Make the smallest change that fixes the behavior.
+5. Run the same suite once more and report its result.
+6. Stop. Do not commit, and do not run the suite again.
+
+If failure is unrelated or not for the expected reason, diagnose it without claiming
+the test-first check passed; fix only what is needed to validate this task.
+Do not silently skip either suite run or report a passing result without its output.
+
+## Step report
+
+End the response with exactly this heading and these four entries:
+- Tests added: ...
+- Suite result: ...
+- Files changed: ...
+- Not done: ...
*** Add File: .github/skills/pr-review/SKILL.md
+---
+name: pr-review
+description: Review the supplied diff for evidence-backed defects without changing files.
+---
+
+Read [AGENTS.md](../../../AGENTS.md) and the supplied diff. Change nothing.
+Report only real defects supported by evidence in the diff or relevant context.
+Do not report style, speculation, or recommendations without a defect.
+
+Output exactly:
+1. `## Review findings`
+2. The table `| ID | Severity | File:line | Finding | Suggested fix |`, with IDs
+   starting at F-01 and increasing; severity must be High, Medium, or Low.
+   If there are no findings, include the header and separator only.
+3. `## Summary` followed by one paragraph.
+
+Do not add other headings, preamble, or sections.
*** Add File: .github/agents/implementer.agent.md
+---
+name: Implementer
+description: Implement one task group or bug list using the required test-first workflow.
+tools: [read, search, edit, execute, agent]
+agents: ["Test Critic"]
+---
+
+First read `.github/skills/tdd-step/SKILL.md` and follow it. For approval work,
+also first read `.github/skills/approval-rules/SKILL.md` and follow it.
+Follow [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md); do not repeat its guidance.
+
+After the implementation passes the required suite, run the **Test Critic**
+subagent on the new tests. Include its test table in your reply. Do not commit.
*** Add File: .github/agents/test-critic.agent.md
+---
+name: Test Critic
+descript

Fix it with one global rule near the top of styles.css: [hidden] { display: none !important; }
This also covers any other element that gets both a display rule and the hidden attribute.
Change nothing else: no JS or HTML edits, no refactoring.

+# Proposal
+
+## Why
+
+Approvals currently allow any configured approver to decide an invoice, regardless of amount. Role-based limits and a second approval for high-value invoices make the demo's approval workflow more realistic and accountable.
+
+## What Changes
+
+- Replace the single `Approver` role with `Manager` and `Director` approval limits; Admins cannot approve.
+- Require a distinct Director after the first Manager or Director approval for amounts above 500,000.00.
+- Return actionable denial errors without changing the invoice.
+- Add demo users, a UI explanation for the second-approval flow, and focused unit and Playwright coverage.
+
+## Capabilities
+
+### New Capabilities
+- `invoice-approval`: Amount- and role-based invoice approval, including distinct two-person approval for high-value invoices.
+
+### Modified Capabilities
+
+## Impact
+
+Approval rules affect `ApprovalService` and invoice state in the Domain project; the API maps denial exceptions to HTTP 403; demo-user configuration and the static approval UI change; unit and Playwright tests cover the behavior.
*** End Patch

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: openspec/changes/add-approval-limits/specs/invoice-approval/spec.md
+# Spec Delta
+
+## Purpose
+
+Defines amount- and role-based invoice approval, including distinct two-person approval for high-value invoices and clear, non-mutating denial behavior.
+
+## ADDED Requirements
+
+### Requirement: Approval authority is limited by role and amount
+The system SHALL allow Managers to approve invoices up to 50,000.00 and Directors to approve invoices up to 500,000.00, inclusive; only a Director may complete approval above 500,000.00.
+
+#### Scenario: Manager approves 50,000.00
+- **WHEN** a Manager approves an invoice for 50,000.00
+- **THEN** the invoice is approved
+
+#### Scenario: Manager cannot approve 50,000.01
+- **WHEN** a Manager attempts to approve an invoice for 50,000.01
+- **THEN** the attempt is denied with a clear reason and the invoice remains unchanged
+
+#### Scenario: Director approves 500,000.00
+- **WHEN** a Director approves an invoice for 500,000.00
+- **THEN** the invoice is approved
+
+#### Scenario: 500,000.01 requires two approvals
+- **WHEN** a Manager or Director approves an invoice for 500,000.01 as the first approver
+- **THEN** the invoice remains PendingApproval and records that approver as the first approver
+
+#### Scenario: Manager is the second approver
+- **WHEN** a Manager attempts to complete approval of an invoice for 500,000.01 after its first approval
+- **THEN** the attempt is denied with a clear reason and the invoice remains unchanged
+
+### Requirement: High-value approvals require two distinct approvers
+For an invoice above 500,000.00, the system SHALL require a Manager or Director first and a distinct Director second. Usernames SHALL be compared after trimming and ignoring case.
+
+#### Scenario: The same user cannot approve twice with different casing
+- **WHEN** the first approver attempts a second approval using the same username with different casing or surrounding whitespace
+- **THEN** the attempt is denied and the invoice remains unchanged
+
+### Requirement: Approval denial preserves the invoice and explains the reason
+When an approval attempt is denied, the system SHALL provide an actionable reason and leave every invoice field unchanged.
+
+#### Scenario: Admin attempts approval
+- **WHEN** an Admin attempts to approve an invoice
+- **THEN** the attempt is denied with a clear reason and the invoice remains unchanged
+
+#### Scenario: API reports a denied approval
+- **WHEN** an approval attempt is denied through the API
+- **THEN** the response has status 403 and a JSON body containing the denial reason in the `error` field
*** End Patch

detail:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: openspec/changes/add-approval-limits/design.md
+# Design
+
+## Context
+
+See `proposal.md` for motivation and `specs/invoice-approval/spec.md` for behavior. `ApprovalService` currently approves a pending invoice in one operation; the API delegates through `Handle(...)`, and the UI displays request errors.
+
+## Goals / Non-Goals
+
+**Goals:**
+- Keep approval policy in the Domain layer and validate the role, amount, and prior approver before changing invoice state.
+- Preserve `PendingApproval` after the first high-value approval and expose the required next approver through the UI.
+
+**Non-Goals:**
+- Prevent races between concurrent approval attempts.
+
+## Decisions
+
+- **Manager and Director replace Approver; Admin cannot approve.** Map the signed-in session to Domain approver types in the controller. This keeps role strings and HTTP concerns out of Domain; retaining a generic Approver role would not express the different limits.
+- **Record the first high-value approver while status remains PendingApproval.** Store `FirstApprovedBy` on the invoice and require a second, distinct Director. This fits the existing lifecycle; adding an intermediate status would change current status handling unnecessarily.
+- **Use Domain `ApprovalDeniedException` for policy denials and map it to HTTP 403 `{ "error": reason }`.** This distinguishes authorization denials from existing 400/404/409 service mappings and gives the UI an actionable message.
+- **Compare usernames after trimming and ignoring case.** This prevents spelling/casing variations from counting the same person twice without requiring a new identity system.
+
+## Risks / Trade-offs
+
+- [Concurrent approvals may race and violate the two-person rule] -> Known risk; concurrency control is out of scope.
+- [Existing approval clients may still use the Approver role] -> Update demo users and approval UI together with the API behavior.
*** End Patch
